articles.title: Robinhood Chain considers technology that gives paying traders priority
articles.snippet: Arbitrum recently replaced its Timeboost transaction-ordering system with a new model called Priority Gas Auctions.

articles.title: New York AG secures up to $35 million and lifetime crypto ban from Celsius’ Alex Mashinsky
articles.snippet: Alex Mashinsky, already serving 12 years for fraud, settled New York’s civil case over claims he misled Celsius customers about the failed crypto lender’s safety.

articles.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
articles.snippet: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

articles.title: DWF Labs subsidiaries sue BitGo for $141 million over alleged token lock-up breach
articles.snippet: DWF is seeking $114 million in damages on the basis BitGo’s token sales resulted in direct losses through the fall in tokens' prices.

articles.title: Zcash developers set January target for quantum-resistant payments after ‘bunker mode’ scare
articles.snippet: The plan concerns public payments, where about seven in 10 ZEC sit. A separate wallet tool would keep balance checks from revealing which addresses belong together.
